capabilities.description: Update the five fixed automatic order-printing cases on the exact stored Store identified by numeric ID or UUID. Only update is supported; settings roots and unrelated settings fields are not accepted.

enabled.description: Whether this fixed automatic order-printing case is enabled for FUTURE orders only.

deviceUuid.description: Canonical UUID of an existing printer device, or null to clear it. Initial partial patches may omit it so the backend merges the stored reference; an explicit null with enabled true is rejected. An effective restored case requires it, non-null, when enabled is true.

templateUuid.description: Canonical UUID of an existing printer template, or null to clear it. Initial partial patches may omit it so the backend merges the stored reference; an explicit null with enabled true is rejected. An effective restored case requires it, non-null, when enabled is true.

copies.description: Copies for this case from 1 through 100; the backend effective configuration defaults to 1.

order.description: FUTURE automatic order printing configuration only: this changes stored settings for orders processed after the change. It never prints now, never creates a print job, and never contacts a printer provider. Case: order for the exact stored Store.
